name: Zhejiang EV-Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang EV-Tech Co Ltd is a China-based company engaged in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of high-voltage power supply systems for new energy vehicles. [18] Its main products include on-board systems like on-board chargers (OBCs), DC/DC converters, and integrated power supply products. [18] The company also produces off-board systems such as power modules for liquid-cooled supercharging piles and intelligent DC charging piles. [18]
